args.command:
cd /output && python3 - <<'EOF'
import random, subprocess
random.seed(42)
cpp = "/workspace/dataset/test12_executable"
rs = "./test12"

cases = []
# random in [0,1] with varied precision
for _ in range(4000):
    cases.append(tuple(f"{random.random():.{random.choice([1,2,3,6,9])}f}" for _ in range(3)))
# structured edges
for v in ["0","1","0.5","0.25","0.75","0.1","0.2","0.3","0.6","0.9","0.999999","0.000001","1e-7","1e7","123.456","-0.5","2.5","-1e-4","0.333333333","3.4028235e38","1.17549435e-38"]:
    for _ in range(4):
        cases.append(tuple(random.choice([v, f"{random.random():.6f}"]) for _ in range(3)))
# equal channels (grays) and near-equal
for v in ["0.3","0.7","0.9999999","1e-8"]:
    cases.append((v,v,v))
cases.append(("0.5","0.50000006","0.5"))
cases.append(("0.1","0.1","0.10000001"))
# very small denominators (max-min tiny)
cases.append(("0.123456","0.123457","0.123458"))

fails = 0
for c in cases:
    o1 = subprocess.run([cpp,*c], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    o2 = subprocess.run([rs,*c], capture_output=True, text=True).stdout
    if o1 != o2:
        fails += 1
        if fails <= 10:
            print("DIFF", c); print("  C++:", o1.strip()); print("  RS :", o2.strip())
print(f"{len(cases)} cases, {fails} mismatches")
EOF
